remainingPropertyPasses.task: Reconcile all91 property outcomes and dependencies, export/inspect/publish the cumulative workbook once using existing machinery, and verify committed source/view/workbook parity. Do not repeat source reviews.

deliveryPolicy.sourcePass: Commit evidence/coverage, cumulative readable GitHub comparison, progress and concise PITON change; reuse existing formats and prior verified type evidence.
deliveryPolicy.workbook: Publish at catalogue/substantial-section checkpoints; prominently identify the workbook snapshot and current source/readable-view checkpoint separately.
deliveryPolicy.noPerPassInfrastructure: No new batch-specific exporter, transfer mechanism, publication script or workflow merely because a source pass ended.
deliveryPolicy.reportsAndLessons: Do not duplicate a separate narrative report, every project index or the entire lessons history after each small change. Add a lesson only for a new substantive finding.
deliveryPolicy.coverageRule: One catalogue entry does not require one candidate DIM row. Preserve individual source traceability for grouped, supporting, excluded or specifically questioned outcomes.
deliveryPolicy.unexpectedDependency: Identify the exact new work before changing the queue. Do not invent completeness, hide unread entries, or launch a new process redesign.
deliveryPolicy.sourcePublicationFailure: Use the existing supported GitHub path, preserve earned work, identify any particular failure honestly; no unbounded repairs or sandbox-only authoritative handoff.

registerOwnerPassMeaning: Parent owner labels remain. remainingPropertyPasses is the active queue; propertyBatches preserves historical assignments only.
publicationRule: GitHub is authoritative for every source pass. Readable source decisions can advance ahead of a separately labeled workbook snapshot; never claim a workbook contains changes not yet exported.
completedTaskRule: Completed ISA-01/02/03A-D work stays complete. Specific questions remain local. Catalogue-level workbook cadence is planned, not a failed delivery or reason to repeat research.

documentationCheckpoint.task: Remove repeated mini-batch release overhead and consolidate the remaining26 property assignments; no new source review, workbook or mapping change
